name: Mitra of the Oath
notes: Varuṇa's divine partner and his opposite in method. Where Varuṇa keeps Ṛta by cold water and pressure, Mitra keeps it by agreement -- an oath witnessed holds because both parties know he heard it. He does not play the cosmic game; he is the reason its players stay bound to the board once Dyauṣ Pitar set the rules.
